title: TransformerLens Hook Coverage Audit: Identifying Which Internal Computations Are Not Accessible

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A coverage map prevents researchers from making claims that require inaccessible activations. This is useful tooling documentation but the safety impact is indirect -- it improves research practice rather than producing a safety finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Enumerating TransformerLens hooks and cross-referencing with GPT-2 forward pass computations is primarily a code-reading and documentation exercise. No GPU compute needed beyond basic validation. Very accessible for CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One library, one model architecture, deliverable is a coverage table. Validating against three published analyses adds some scope but is well-bounded. Primarily documentation work. Fits 30 hours comfortably.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
